title: horsfieldia subtilis

It is native to the tropical regions of Southeast Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. Horsfieldia subtilis has been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin and other tissues from damage.
